_comment: Hosted heavy-model tier. Every provider ships DISABLED. To use one: set enabled=true in %APPDATA%/GameForge/hosted_providers.json, store the API key in Windows Credential Manager (target GameForge/<provider_id>) or the named env var, fill in current per-million-token prices from the provider's price page, and opt the workspace in via .gameforge/egress.json. Prices are intentionally 0 here: a metered model with unknown prices is refused.
